extracted.intended_audience: NIH eRA Commons users (program directors/principal investigators and signing officials)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and explanations for PD/PIs and Signing Officials (SOs) on how to view an application's summary statement, numerical scores, percentile, and related review information in eRA Commons; also explains what the scores mean and how they are calculated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall impact score
rubrics_metrics.description: After peer review, the application receives an overall impact score.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The overall impact score is the average of the 1–9 scores assigned by each voting reviewer, multiplied by 10 (i.e., average score × 10). The overall impact score appears in the eRA Commons Status Information screen and in the Summary Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentile score
rubrics_metrics.description: A percentile ranking may be assigned to the application's impact/priority score.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The percentile score represents the relative position or rank of an impact/priority score within the scores assigned by a particular study section, reported along a 100.0 percentile band.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nine-point rating scale
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH peer review uses a 9-point rating scale for reviewer scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scores run from 1 to 9 where 1 = exceptional and 9 = poor. These numeric reviewer scores are used to compute the overall impact score (average of voting reviewers' 1–9 scores, then multiplied by 10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary statement content
rubrics_metrics.description: The summary statement includes reviewers' critiques and numerical scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Scientific Review Officer (SRO) provides a Summary Statement that contains reviewers' written critiques and the numerical scores for review criteria and overall impact; the Summary Statement is available as a PDF from the eRA Commons 'Other Relevant Documents' section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numerical scores for at least five review criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The Summary Statement provides numerical scores for each of (at least) five review criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this page does not list the criterion names, the Summary Statement includes the reviewers' numeric ratings for each required review criterion (at least five), which together with written critiques inform the overall impact assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access permissions and who can view outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Which roles can view the summary statement, score, and percentile information in eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both the PI and Signing Official(s) (SO) can view the Summary Statement, score, and percentile information. You must be logged into eRA Commons with the appropriate role(s) to access these documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability timeframe for review outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: When review outcomes typically become available in eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Summary Statement, score, and percentile information are usually available in eRA Commons within 30 days of the application's peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure to view review outcomes in eRA Commons (PI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step actions a PI should take in eRA Commons to view the Summary Statement and scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log into eRA Commons → select 'Status' from the landing page or apps menu → click 'List of Applications/Grants' → select the application ID link → on the Status Information screen, locate 'Other Relevant Documents' and click the 'Summary Statement' link (opens in a separate window) to access critiques and numeric scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure to view review outcomes in eRA Commons (SO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step actions an SO should take in eRA Commons to view the Summary Statement and scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log into eRA Commons → select 'Status' from the landing page or apps menu → on the General Search screen enter criteria and click 'Search' → in Search Results click the Applications/Award ID → on the Status Information screen, scroll to 'Other Relevant Documents' and click the 'Summary Statement' link (appears only if peer review completed). Expand the Review section to see abbreviated review info including percentile and impact score.
